subject: Error deploying an app, likely caused by BiocGenerics package

messages.author: 615e5313dfc84fcc
messages.subject: Error deploying an app, likely caused by BiocGenerics package
parts:
Hi all,

The title says it all. I tried to deploy an app via RStudio/GUI to the shiny server, but failed. The error is:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 64874...DONE
Deploying bundle: 292321 for application: 64874 ...
Waiting for task: 93416301
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Fetching packages
  error: Building package: BiocGenerics
################################ Begin Task Log ################################ 
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 93416314 error: Unhandled Exception: 
Execution halted

BiocGenerics is necessary for the topGO package. My complete imports are: 

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(MBCluster.Seq)
library(topGO)

When I start the app in RStudio it runs, but throws a warning:

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:4369
Found more than one class "connection" in cache; using the first, from namespace 'BiocGenerics'

Any advice how to deploy ? I already tried updating shiny and Bioconductor as well as reinstalling BiocGenerics.

And congrats on a great product.

Cheers,

Stefan

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error deploying an app, likely caused by BiocGenerics package

Thanks for reporting the issue. This is a problem with the shinyapps.io service that we identified yesterday related to downloading packages via HTTPS from Bioconductor. We're working on a fix right now, and I think we'll be able to get it released today. 

-Andy

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error deploying an app, likely caused by BiocGenerics package
parts:
Hi Andy, 

This is the exact error I'm getting:
Found more than one class "connection" in cache; using the first, from namespace 'BiocGenerics'

Code is below:

ui.R: 

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("censusVis"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      helpText("Here goes nothing...")
      
    ),
    mainPanel(grVizOutput("picture"))
  )
))

server.R
library(DiagrammeR)

diagram <- "
digraph {

# graph attributes
graph [overlap = true]

# node attributes
node [shape = box,
fontname = Helvetica,
color = blue]

# edge attributes
edge [color = gray]

# node statements
A; B; C; D; E
F [color = black]

# node attributes
node [shape = circle,
fixedsize = true,
width = 0.9]

# node statements
1; 2; 3; 4; 5; 6; 7; 8

# edge statements
A->1; B->2                   // gray
B->3 [color = red]           // red
B->4                         // gray
C->A [color = green]         // green
1->D; E->A; 2->4; 1->5; 1->F // gray
E->6; 4->6; 5->7; 6->7       // gray
3->8 [color = blue]          // blue
}
"
shinyServer(
  function(input, output) {
    output$picture<-renderGrViz({
      grViz({
      diagram
    })
    })
   
  }
) 

This works fine for me locally. I see the error about the namespace above, but I can runApp() successfully. However, when I try to publish, I get "ERROR: Cannot find function "grVizOutput"

I don't have these errors if I refrain from using the DiagrammeR package 

I'm totally stumped, thanks for all of your help.
